code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with lymphopenia and neutropenia, and elevated monocytes and basophils. There is mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine, high-normal potassium), low total protein, and low ALT. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible infection, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
